Resolved by P1 (agent).

WO-4181288 (seq 7, preventive, booked 2026-06-17) has no completed row and no rebooking; grace 3 business days long past; the only missed_visit credit is for WO-4180395. **False at the opening** (rows da8cd509 booked; no completed row for that work order; credit 87098a5d is for another work order). Base eligibility inherited: not customer-moved (no reschedule_request in `maintenance_requests`), not a no-access closure. Resolved by P2 (agent).
3. "…not taken until the balance carries the price of every visit performed beyond the visits the term credited." Term credited 8 (entitlement row 8b49d2bc, visit_sequence 8). Base: "A completed visit consumes one visit … a visit closed as no-access consumes none." The one extra_visit fee row (7e8ea066) is tied to WO-4181455 (07-08, the seventh consuming completion), so neither beyond-entitlement visit carries a charge. **False at the opening.** Resolved by P3 (agent).

Tree: P4 <- P1 (value_input via `late_fee_charges`), P4 <- P2 (value_input via `credits_applied`), P4 <- P3 (value_input via `other_fee_charges`). n = 3 prerequisite problems, 3 value_input edges >= max(n-1,1) = 2.
